meta.title: deepseek golden partner
meta.description: Packs repository context into one file for an external planning model, then brings the plan back as a file under plans/.
meta.detail: Two tools: handoff_pack writes a context pack (tree, stack, conventions, key-file heads); plan_intake turns clipboard text into a dated plan file with a status header and reports its section headings. Both return only a path and counts, so long text never enters the conversation.
